title: Work & Projects
description: Screenshots of the products I build: a self-hosted CI/CD platform, a secrets manager, pharmacy software and a desktop media player.

items.title: RunXR, a self-hosted CI/CD platform
items.alt: RunXR landing page in dark mode with the headline Build. Test. Ship. and a terminal window showing a successful build log
items.caption: RunXR is a self-hosted CI/CD platform with GitHub login, signed webhooks, persistent build jobs, live logs and isolated Docker runners. This is its landing page, with a live build log on the right.

items.title: Evnar, a calm secrets manager
items.alt: Evnar landing page on a cream background with the headline Keep the keys. Lose the chaos. next to a workspace showing masked environment variables
items.caption: Evnar is a CLI-first secrets manager with encrypted storage and environment-scoped workflows. The landing page shows a workspace with masked API keys and environment variables.

items.title: GalenDesk pharmacy dashboard
items.alt: GalenDesk dashboard for Almulik Pharmacy with colourful tiles for sales, expiring stock and out-of-stock items, and a sidebar with inventory and transactions
items.caption: GalenDesk is an offline-first pharmacy inventory and point-of-sale app with FEFO stock deduction and batch tracking. This is the main dashboard with today's sales, expiring and out-of-stock summaries.

items.title: Marigold Player video library
items.alt: Marigold Player desktop media player in dark mode showing a grid of nine colourful video thumbnails in the Aurora Collection folder
items.caption: Marigold Player is an open-source desktop media player for video and music that plays almost any format through a bundled FFmpeg. This is the video library with thumbnails, durations and search.
